name: forgejo-issues
description: Browse the current repo's Forgejo or Gitea issues in a pane

apiUrl.title: API URL override
apiUrl.description: Base of the Forgejo API when it is not https://<remote host>/api/v1, for a remote whose SSH host differs from its web host. Leave empty to derive it from the git remote.

requireCommentOnClose.title: Comment before closing
requireCommentOnClose.description: Closing an issue needs a comment, posted first and then the close, so every closed issue says why

requireMilestone.title: New issues need a milestone
requireMilestone.description: The new-issue form refuses to file an issue until a milestone is picked

requireLabelFrom.title: New issues need one of these labels
requireLabelFrom.description: Comma-separated label names (for example a set of type labels); the new-issue form refuses to file until one is picked. Empty for no rule.

editorCommand.title: External editor command
editorCommand.description: Command that opens a file for editing and exits when you are done, {file} standing for the path (appended when absent). For example: ghostty --gtk-single-instance=false --class=popup.editor -e nvim {file}. Empty hides the Open in editor button.
